reviews.title: CHARGING BACK PLEASE 😭
reviews.text:
I actually loved the Charging update, so I was really disappointed to see it removed.

Now I have to manually open the app and select what I’m doing — working, focusing, cleaning, etc. I have ADHD, so I constantly forget to do this. I can spend 3–5 hours doing important things and then open the app only to find 0 points, simply because I forgot to press the button.

That’s exactly why Charging worked so much better for me — it was automatic and didn’t require me to remember another thing.

Please bring Charging back, or at least let users choose between Charging and the classic system. 🙏

And honestly, I’m shocked because I saw so many reviews asking you to bring the old system back when Charging was introduced. 😂 I was the complete opposite — I loved Charging!

reviews.title: It’s like finding out you’re getting cheated on
reviews.text:
I am writing this review out because I find this situation actually revolting.
This was my favorite app ever: It helped me gain my life back, study, have an organized environment and improved my mental health. I went from 10 hours of screentime to 2-3 hours a day.

The app was very aesthetic, gamified your routine, and provided coins as you completed different activities.
I have no clue who had the RIDICULOUS idea of changing the app, maybe someone who woke up and thought “hmm my app is really popular, however I am really miserable because my wife doesn’t love me, let me completely change the concept of the app entirely.”

We, the users of the app, woke up one day to an update that NOBODY asked for. Perhaps the developers are amazing at coding, but lack reading comprehension: They looked at reviews that said “hey can we get a way to get coins when we forget to start the timer?” and decided make a completely different app. The new version is a battery that charges BY ITSELF and using distracting apps drains the battery. 

It wouldn’t be so terrible if that was the only change, but these are the things that the i-suck-at-understanding-user-requests-developers decided to do:

A)Remove ALL the quests and challenges in the app to gain extra coins.
B)Made the design extremely minimalistic, removed the cute brain mascot and changed it to a simple battery.
C)Most of the time, the apps don’t even block. You go on the app to reset the block, and it doesn’t block. Great, so now I pay a subscription for an app that doesn’t work.
D) Before, you could change the amount of coins it would cost to use your phone. For example, level 1 is 1 coin=1 minute, and so on (there were 5 different levels). However, the developers changed it to a system that is overly complex (I can’t even explain it, because I genuinely don’t understand the math behind it). Additionally, it is difficult to adjust it to the right level: 45min of scrolling time in one sitting is way too much time. 15min-20min in one sitting sounds like a good goal, however, it takes around 8 hours to charge again and 4 hours if you use the focus mode (or whatever it’s called). Oh, and you can only adjust the scrolling time if you wait 24 HOURS (before you had to wait 5min to change it.)

Nobody in their right mind wants to pay for an app that has a simple battery and no other feature. 
I know I sound quite harsh, but this has been one of the biggest disappointments I had with a product. This app changed my life and I did not mind paying a small subscription because of the rewards that lowering my screentime brought.

I know if my review gets read, it’s not going to be taken seriously: It’s going to be broadcast onto a meeting while the developers drink their $6 lattes and laugh on why someone cares so much about a product. 
You can’t build an app that helps people greatly, charge for it, and then rip the features out of people’s hands.
Be better, money isn’t everything.

reviews.title: What a difference!
reviews.text:
I don’t EVER pay for apps (or in-app purchases) if I don’t have to and I rarely EVER write reviews for apps either. This app has completely changed my life though! Truly! I had the 3-day free trial to give it a go and see what it could do for me and WOW! What a difference I already see! I’ve always wanted to stop my doom (and even hope) scrolling, because the amount of hours the rabbit hole went down was literally all day almost every day! I felt like I had no control over my own life and my own choices and it turned into a real addiction! I’ve tried other app-blocking apps and though they kept me off of there, I always found a way to get around it with loop holes (and mainly a lack of self-control.) I knew I not only needed something to restrict me, (much like a parent would,) but I also needed to find something that replaced my bad habit of scrolling with healthy ones. And this app has done EXACTLY that and more for me! The cute little brain buddy helps too, because of course one wants to help our lil’ guy keep happy! 🥹 On top of that I just found on the website a custom dopamine menu and I need to next see how that might potentially be in the app! (If it isn’t already, please put it in there!)

Nonetheless, in super short, (after a really long review haha) I decided to keep the app AND pay for the annual subscription! 😱 It is currently WELL worth it in my opinion to get my sanity back and to literally feel like I have 2-3 days of time in my one day now that I’m not scrolling anymore! I now feel like I earn my time on social media, which helps my dopamine levels, and I don’t feel like I’m restricted on times like other apps. Instead I can choose these moments throughout the day and I’ve even noticed that I don’t need to be on there for more than a few minutes at a time and then the app blocks me before I go down my usual rabbit hole. I’ve also already noticed I tend to choose to go on WAY less and the emotional rollercoaster (and headaches and extreme overwhelm) I once felt from the constant topic changes on social media have now switched to peace of mind. And I couldn’t be more grateful for it! (Thank you, guys! Truly!!! From the bottom of my heart!! And brain! Haha)

Now to find more healthy options to replace the empty time! Like socializing (in person!) and finding new communities! (As someone who normally has social anxiety I can’t believe I’m saying this!!) But first and foremost, above all, rest!

Thank you again, Unrot!
I can’t appreciate enough that I’ve got my life back now! 🫶💝
